steps.en: Add the plugin to dsh's web profile, then start the web UI
steps.zh: 把插件装进 dsh 的 web profile，再启动 Web UI
steps.code: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context · dsh web

steps.en: Registers projection units that fold every session event into a per-request context timeline
steps.zh: 注册投影单元，把会话每个事件折叠成逐请求的上下文时间线

steps.en: Work in a session as usual
Shows a Context tab beside Chat, plus a right-sidebar panel and a dashboard entry
steps.zh: 在“对话”旁显示 Context 标签页，另加右侧栏面板和仪表盘入口

steps.en: Type the slash command, or open the Context tab
steps.zh: 输入斜杠命令，或打开 Context 标签页

steps.en: Breaks each request into what it was built from, token-priced, with compactions and prunes marked
steps.zh: 把每次请求拆成组成部分并标出 token 价，压缩和剪枝事件都钉在图上

value.en: See which part of the window eats your tokens and what compaction removed, without digging through session logs
value.zh: 不翻会话日志，就能看清是哪部分在吃上下文、压缩又删掉了什么

sources: README.md bowenliang123/dsh-context main @ 2026-09-30: 'Install with dsh cli' verbatim 'dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context' and 'Then start the web UI with `dsh web`'; '/context command' section: 'Type `/context` (or pick it from the `/` menu) and press Enter'; Context tab / Context panel / Context Dashboard sections; Context Browser and Context Events sections (element-level token price, compaction and prune markers)
src/host/index.ts @ main 2026-09-30: `inject = ['sessionProjections']`, `ctx.sessionProjections.register(createContextTimelineDefinition(...))` plus headers and activity units
src/client/index.ts @ main 2026-09-30: registers the Context tab in the `conversation.view` slot; package.json `dsh.client.platform: "web"`
